ownerDecision: Owner-adjudicated decisive-only correction after interrupted v2 reference; restart all comparisons on v3, do not reuse the partial run.
rule: Decisive means a reader missing this fact would get the case wrong. Every family contrast target is decisive in all four states. Retain distinct claim foundations, material independent grounds, remedy prerequisites and material procedural/prior-adjudication facts. A redundant negative alternative to an affirmed ground, or ancillary history not needed for a sought remedy, is not decisive. Polarity never by itself determines decisiveness. Non-target absent questions are not decisive; absence is still scored densely and forbidden affirmations remain unchanged.
priorInference: 25 v2 fitting reference calls only, discarded from all future comparisons; no candidate/audit/validation inference
